functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_yorisou_agent_runtime_task(p_task_id uuid, p_worker_id text, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 60)
 RETURNS SETOF agent_runtime_tasks
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_worker_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$' or p_lease_seconds not between 1 and 300 then
    raise exception 'invalid claim input';
  end if;
  return query update public.agent_runtime_tasks
    set status='claimed', claimed_by=p_worker_id, claimed_at=now(), lease_expires_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds), attempt_count=attempt_count+1
    where id=p_task_id and project_id='yorisou' and status='ready' and available_at<=now()
    returning public.agent_runtime_tasks.*;
end $function$

functions.full_args: p_worker_id text, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_yorisou_agent_runtime_tasks(p_worker_id text, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 1)
 RETURNS SETOF agent_runtime_tasks
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ begin if p_worker_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$' or p_lease_seconds not between 1 and 300 or p_batch_size not between 1 and 20 then raise exception 'invalid claim input'; end if; return query with c as (select id from public.agent_runtime_tasks where project_id='yorisou' and status='ready' and available_at<=now() order by priority,available_at,id for update skip locked limit p_batch_size) update public.agent_runtime_tasks t set status='claimed',claimed_by=p_worker_id,claimed_at=now(),lease_expires_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds),attempt_count=t.attempt_count+1 from c where t.id=c.id returning t.*; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_yorisou_candidate_organization(p_source_type text, p_display_name text, p_external_domain text, p_external_ref text, p_commercial_relationship text, p_related_project_ref text, p_conflict_of_interest_disclosure text, p_notes text, p_actor text, p_actor_type text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_row public.yorisou_candidate_organizations;
begin
  insert into public.yorisou_candidate_organizations (
    source_type, display_name, external_domain, external_ref,
    commercial_relationship, related_project_ref, conflict_of_interest_disclosure,
    notes, created_by, created_by_type
  ) values (
    p_source_type, p_display_name, p_external_domain, p_external_ref,
    coalesce(p_commercial_relationship, 'unknown_review'), p_related_project_ref,
    p_conflict_of_interest_disclosure, p_notes, p_actor, coalesce(p_actor_type, 'admin')
  ) returning * into v_row;

  insert into public.yorisou_candidate_events (project_id, organization_id, event_type, actor, actor_type, new_state)
    values ('yorisou', v_row.id, 'created', p_actor, coalesce(p_actor_type, 'admin'), 'active');

  return to_jsonb(v_row);
end $function$

end $function$

functions.name: enforce_yorisou_agent_runtime_transition
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_yorisou_agent_runtime_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin if new.project_id<>'yorisou' then raise exception 'project namespace forbidden'; end if; if new.status<>old.status and not ((old.status='queued' and new.status in ('ready','scheduled','paused','cancelled')) or (old.status='scheduled' and new.status in ('ready','paused','cancelled')) or (old.status='ready' and new.status in ('claimed','paused','cancelled')) or (old.status='claimed' and new.status in ('running','ready','failed','paused','cancelled')) or (old.status='running' and new.status in ('completed','waiting_for_review','retry_wait','failed','paused','cancelled')) or (old.status='waiting_for_review' and new.status in ('ready','paused','cancelled')) or (old.status='retry_wait' and new.status in ('ready','failed','paused','cancelled')) or (old.status='failed' and new.status='dead_letter') or (old.status='paused' and new.status in ('ready','cancelled'))) then raise exception 'illegal transition'; end if; if new.status in ('ready','paused','cancelled','failed') then new.claimed_by=null; new.claimed_at=null; new.lease_expires_at=null; end if; new.updated_at=now(); return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_yorisou_experience_card_rate()
 RETURNS trigger

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.promote_yorisou_agent_runtime_tasks(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ declare n integer; begin if p_batch_size not between 1 and 100 then raise exception 'invalid promotion bounds'; end if; with c as (select id from public.agent_runtime_tasks where project_id='yorisou' and status in ('queued','scheduled','retry_wait') and available_at<=now() and (scheduled_at is null or scheduled_at<=now()) order by priority,available_at,id for update skip locked limit p_batch_size) update public.agent_runtime_tasks t set status='ready' from c where t.id=c.id; get diagnostics n=row_count; return n; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_yorisou_recommendation_action(p_item_id uuid, p_owner text, p_action text, p_idempotency_key text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ declare v_id uuid; begin if p_owner !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,200}$' or p_action not in ('viewed','reason_viewed','saved','try_intent','tried','helpful','not_helpful','not_relevant','hidden','reported','resource_opened') or char_length(p_idempotency_key) not between 16 and 200 then raise exception 'invalid recommendation action'; end if; if (select count(*) from public.yorisou_recommendation_actions where owner_account_id=p_owner and created_at>now()-interval '1 hour')>=60 then raise exception 'recommendation action rate limited'; end if; insert into public.yorisou_recommendation_actions(project_id,owner_account_id,recommendation_item_id,action,idempotency_key,note) values('yorisou',p_owner,p_item_id,p_action,p_idempotency_key,p_note) on conflict(owner_account_id,idempotency_key) do update set idempotency_key=excluded.idempotency_key returning id into v_id; return v_id; end $function$

functions.name: recover_stale_yorisou_agent_runtime_tasks
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recover_stale_yorisou_agent_runtime_tasks()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ declare n integer; begin update public.agent_runtime_tasks set status=case when attempt_count>=maximum_attempts then 'failed' when status='claimed' then 'ready' else 'retry_wait' end, available_at=now(), claimed_by=null, claimed_at=null, lease_expires_at=null,error_class=case when attempt_count>=maximum_attempts then 'attempts_exhausted' else 'stale_lease' end,error_summary=case when attempt_count>=maximum_attempts then 'Maximum attempts exhausted' else 'Lease expired before task completion' end where project_id='yorisou' and status in ('claimed','running') and lease_expires_at<now(); get diagnostics n=row_count; return n; end $function$
